title: Dev-server proxy cuts Engram enablement Verify/Save at 120 s and reports the backend as unavailable
outcome: ui/vite.config.ts proxies '/api' with timeout/proxyTimeout 120_000 and answers a proxy error with a plain 502 ('The TermAl backend is unavailable. Start it again and wait for reconnect.'); api-request.ts maps 502/503/504 to the generic backend-unavailable error. The backend's Engram enablement (verify and the PATCH that repeats it) runs 'engram doctor' under a 300 s deadline; on the Engram repo's 2.4 GB store the doctor takes 110 s standalone and the verify route answers 200 verified=true in 126 s. Through the dev server the request is cut at 120 s, so the operator sees 'Verify failed · The TermAl backend is unavailable.' and cannot enable Engram. Fix applied (uncommitted, 2026-09-15): raise the '/api' proxy timeout/proxyTimeout to 360_000 so the proxy outlives the backend's longest bounded request, with a comment naming why. Follow-up to consider: have the settings panel keep the backend's own error text instead of the generic 502 mapping, and show a 'this can take a few minutes' hint while verifying.
